text:
alyssa: Heads up — planning a rolling maintenance in apac-west1 tonight 03:15 local (UTC+8) for PSU firmware + NIC microcode. Expect soft reboots across 3 racks, ~10% GPU capacity impacted at any time. Need backfill plan and customer comms. @ops-oncall @sophie

sophie: ACK. Quick ask — APAC traffic peaks 01:30-03:30, can we shift to 03:15–07:15 to reduce user impact?

max: +1 to shifting. Operational plan: stagger 1 rack every 20m, pre-seed KV cache on the next rack ~8m before drain completes so warmups don't cause latency spikes.

kai: I'll run the canary. Canonical drain command I plan to use:```bash
rtool drain --pool=apac-west1 --rack=rack-17 --grace=600 --notify=ops
```Monitor node-health and kv-cache-hit-rate while draining.

marco: Cost check — if we spin up burst GPUs for backfill we'll see ~+$2.2k for the 4h window (est). Do we have signoff to use burst capacity vs throttling traffic? @finance FYI.

sophie: CS/Support: please prep customer comms. Short email + FAQ about expected transient latency and automatic EU fallback. I'll draft and share for review.

ops-oncall: Oncall here — creating the incident doc and rota now. Will add a short runbook and page: https://redwood.in/incident/6076543210

infra-bot: scheduled maintenance created: 2026-03-23T19:15:00Z window 4h. Affected reserved customers will be notified. Reminder: autopause for low-priority jobs enabled. :robot_face:

alyssa: Also add a route-policy override to prefer EU for read-heavy paths during the window: `route_policy: prefer-eu-on-maint`. That should keep UX acceptable for global apps.

max: Canary test plan: send 1k small generation requests -> monitor p95 and error rate. Abort if p95 > 250ms or errors > 0.5%. I'll post telemetry checkpoints in #eng-runtime during the run.

kai: I'll be on call during the window. Ping me in this thread and in #eng-oncall if anything degrades. :thumbsup:

sophie: Draft done, sending to CS for review. Will tag legal if compliance customers are impacted.

marco: If we want to avoid burst costs, consider restricting Dedicated tenants to degraded throughput with priority routing. That keeps costs lower but we must warn customers.

alyssa: Decision: shift window to 03:15 local, follow stagger 1 rack / 20m, preseed caches, EU fallback enabled, canary thresholds as max outlined. Ops doc link in incident page. Thanks everyone.
